PART3_positional_encoding_excluded.finding: the positional phase encoding is a GRAM-INVARIANT unitary rotation: it changes every wave's coordinates but preserves every pairwise inner product. Any similarity-based readout (kNN, ridge, Hopfield) is therefore blind to it.
PART3_positional_encoding_excluded.consequence: positional=True and pos_multifreq=True CANNOT change the rank or any cosine-based readout. The D131 remedy family is excluded as a rank fix.
PART3_positional_encoding_excluded.spec_A_relationship: consistent with docs/SPEC_A_trainable_ingress_v1.md section 8, which already measured D131 aliasing (IRIRIR cos to IR = 1.000000). This turn adds WHY the family cannot fix the rank: Gram invariance.

PART4_confounded_arm_recorded_not_used.design: dk_target=0 vs dk_target=32 as two separately built systems
why_confounded: it measured the rank of the RAW WAVE, which passes through no pooling, so dk_target cannot affect it (identical eff_rank 46, capacity 0.5029)

dk_target changes the parameter count, so the whole-construction RNG fork consumes a different stream and the INGRESS INIT DIFFERS between arms (ridge_held 0.1862 vs 0.1780 despite identical wave features)
PART4_confounded_arm_recorded_not_used.status: NOT USED AS EVIDENCE. Retained on record. The signal comparing two separately built systems is never attributable.
